text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Hey~, we can't see the sky at all~! Are we 
really gonna see shooting stars~?

Today, we came to help out at an event 
watching a meteor shower with the 
children, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sunset is in about an hour, however... 
Judging by the weather chart, prospects do 
not look promising.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, it might clear up after all! Let's 
believe and wait and see~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hope so as well. However, making an 
early judgment call is also a wise 
decision. As our supervisor, what are your 
thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll "make" a shooting star!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me☆ Let's go to Tracen 
Academy★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Sorry to keep you waiting~~!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show you a marvelous shooting 
star that you can only see at Tracen 
Academy!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Here I goooo~~☆★☆
(*fwooooosh*)

Beneath the cloudy sky, faint specks of 
light flickered softly. It was the 
trailing afterglow of penlights as 
Marvelous Sunday ran. ...A light far 
removed from an actual shooting star.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Ahahaha☆

Even so, Marvelous Sunday kept running. 
The light from the penlights began to 
accelerate...!
(*SWHOOOOOOOSH...!!*)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
More and more! Not yet, not yet! 
Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My, when did the sky clear up? Th-This 
is...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Sparkly and dazzling!! Marvelouuuuus☆★☆

The clouds had dispersed, revealing a 
starry sky. It was as if the foul weather 
earlier had been an illusion.
(*shiiiiiing*☆)

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I saw it! A shooting star! It went 
flash!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, that irregular trajectory... It 
defies the normal movement of a shooting 
star...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It flew away! A-Amaaazing...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Are we experiencing a collective 
hallucination? Because that was...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Come on, it's time for the finale!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The marvelous surrounding this planet☆ 
Thank you for the sparkly memories~~!!
(*fwaaaash*...!!)

Before we knew it, both the meteors and 
the mysterious lights had vanished, 
leaving behind an ordinary night sky...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha☆ That was so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was beautiful, but... I am also 
intrigued by the true nature of that 
flying light.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what is your assessment of the 
phenomenon just now?
choice_data_list:
I'd like to verify it with my own eyes 
once more...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is a realistic line of reasoning. 
Even so, I would like to analyze the parts 
that remain unexplained...

A few days after that mysterious 
experience, Marvelous Sunday and the 
others came up to speak with me.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! The kids from the other day drew 
a picture of what happened back then!

Depicted on the paper were countless 
shooting stars... and an intensely 
brilliant, radiant light.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So everyone experienced the exact same 
thing after all... It seems we cannot 
dismiss the events of that day as a mere 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It was a truly marvelous night☆ 
Marvelou~~s★

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... Coming from you, Marvelous-san, 
it carries a strange sense of persuasion. 
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, Marvelous-san. Once 
more, please.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then, then, let's all do it together this 
time!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Marvelou~~s!

We all swung our penlights together, but 
there was no sign of the mysterious light 
appearing. Has it already "returned" home, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there are specific conditions 
required, such as the way we wave the 
penlights or the timing.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
But, but, it feels like we turned into 
little stars ourselves, it's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah☆ Spreading the marvelous together★ 
I'm sure it's reaching someone out there☆
